q: Why does a follow-up like 'make it shorter' work well in an AI chat?
options: The assistant saves every reply to a file it can edit later
The assistant searches the web again for a shorter version
The assistant reads the whole conversation so far, not just your last message
The assistant remembers all your past chats across every account
explain: Each reply is generated from the entire conversation in that chat, so short follow-up instructions apply to the earlier draft.

q: Using the traffic-light rule, how should you treat an AI answer giving the GST rate on restaurant services?
options: Red: verify it on an official government source or with your CA
Yellow: spot-check it against a similar summary you have
Green: read it once, edit to taste and use it
Green, if the assistant sounded confident and clear
explain: Numbers, laws and rates are red-zone output, so every fact must be verified with an official or original source.

q: Your company runs on Outlook and Teams and has approved one AI tool for work data. Which assistant should you prefer for work?
options: Whichever assistant gave the best caption in a test
The approved tool, ideally the one built into your Microsoft 365 apps
Any free assistant, as long as you use your personal account
The assistant with the most shared prompts online
explain: Choose based on where your work lives and what your company allows; the approved, built-in tool fits best for work data.

q: Neha wants AI-written saree descriptions that match the style of two she already likes. What is the most effective approach?
options: Describe the style as elegant and short
Ask for ten versions and pick the closest one
Paste the two examples and ask for new ones in the same style and length
Give the AI a role as a famous fashion writer
explain: Few-shot examples teach length, rhythm and vocabulary far better than a description of the style.

q: Shalini needs to chase a vendor about late deliveries but keep the relationship. Which approach does the course recommend?
options: Write the facts as rough notes and ask AI to shape them with a firm but respectful tone
Ask AI to write the email from scratch using only the vendor's name
Let AI decide the tone, since it knows what vendors expect
Ask AI for the most formal tone possible so it sounds serious
explain: Your notes carry the facts while the AI handles structure and politeness, with the tone you specify.

q: Kiran's saved prompt for vendor emails scores 3 out of 5 after testing. What should she do next?
options: Delete it and write a new prompt from scratch each time
Keep using it, since any saved prompt is better than none
Switch assistants until one rates the output higher
Run the prompt improver meta-prompt on it and test again
explain: Prompts rated below 4 are refined with the prompt improver and retested on real tasks.

q: A shop owner asks AI to translate a closure notice into Hindi but gets stiff textbook Hindi. What should she ask for instead?
options: A word-for-word translation so nothing is lost
Natural, friendly Hindi as a shopkeeper would speak to regular customers
The same notice in English with Hindi headings only
A longer version so the Hindi sounds more complete
explain: Asking for natural, local phrasing and a clear register produces wording customers would actually use.

q: Ravi wants AI to become a daily habit at work. Which tasks should he pick as his first three anchor tasks?
options: His most sensitive tasks, where mistakes are most costly
Rare tasks he does once a quarter, to save the most effort
Frequent, time-consuming, low-risk tasks like writing and summarising
Every task in his week at once, to see results faster
explain: Starting with frequent, time-consuming, low-risk tasks and linking them to fixed times builds a lasting habit.

q: Vikram needs a 2-page report on rising complaints at his branch. What is the best first step with AI?
options: Ask it to write the whole report in one go, then edit
Give a brief with purpose, reader and key facts, then ask for an outline only
Ask for an executive summary first and expand from it
Ask it to research typical complaint causes online
explain: The outline-first method starts with a brief and an outline you fix, keeping you in control of the argument.

q: While drafting a work-from-home policy, how do you stop AI from silently inventing rules your company never agreed?
options: Ask for the policy in plain text with no markdown
Ask it to keep the policy under one page
Give it a role as a senior HR manager
Ask it to mark points needing a company decision with [DECIDE]
explain: The [DECIDE] marker flags decisions for you instead of letting the AI make up commitments.

q: In the synthesis step of research, why include the phrase 'using ONLY this information'?
options: It keeps the AI grounded in your verified sources instead of adding unverified facts
It makes the AI search the web for more current sources
It tells the AI to shorten the brief to a single page
It lets the AI pick the most reliable of your sources
explain: Restricting the AI to your checked extracts prevents it from mixing in its own unverified claims.

q: You ask an AI about a contract's termination notice period. Which instruction makes the answer easiest to verify?
options: Quote the exact sentence and say which clause it comes from
Summarise the whole contract in five bullet points first
Explain the notice period in simple everyday language
Compare it with typical notice periods in other contracts
explain: Exact quotes point to real text you can find with Ctrl+F, which catches invented or blurred details.

q: An assistant analyses your uploaded sales file and reports top customers. What should you do before relying on it?
options: Accept it, because uploaded files are always read accurately
Ask it to redo the analysis as a chart instead
Spot-check results yourself and ask which columns it used
Upload the file to a second assistant and average the results
explain: Numbers are red-zone output, so spot-check results, match totals and confirm the AI used the right columns.

q: Copilot in Outlook cannot find a document a colleague mentioned. What is the most likely explanation?
options: Copilot only works with documents created in Word
The document is too long for Copilot to read
Copilot needs a personal account to search files
You may not have permission to access that document
explain: Copilot works within your existing permissions, so it cannot surface content you are not allowed to see.

q: Deepa wants to use Gemini on a work document her company has not approved for AI. What does the course advise?
options: Move the file to her personal Google account and use Gemini there
Copy the text into the Gemini app on her phone instead
Upload it anyway, since Google protects all Drive files
Not move work files into a personal account; follow her employer's rules
explain: Work and personal accounts are governed differently, so work documents should stay within tools your employer approves.

q: When converting rough meeting notes into minutes, which instruction best prevents AI errors?
options: Ask for the minutes in a more formal tone
Do not invent anything; write TBD for unclear owners or dates and mark tentative items
Assign every task to the person who first mentioned it
Keep the minutes under 100 words so they are easy to read
explain: Without these rules, AI may confidently assign owners or turn 'maybe 10 Nov' into a firm commitment.

q: Pooja is tailoring her resume with AI and lacks a skill the job asks for. What should her prompt tell the AI to do?
options: Add the skill briefly, since recruiters rarely check
Rewrite her job titles to imply the skill
List the missing skill separately as a gap instead of adding it
Remove the requirement from the job description
explain: AI should tailor real experience, never invent it; missing items are flagged as gaps to address honestly.

q: Arjun needs help with an email about a client's late deliverable. What is the safest way to use a general AI tool?
options: Replace the client's name and figures with placeholders like Company X, then add them back later
Paste the full email thread, since chats are deleted after a day
Use his personal account so the company is not involved
Paste the details but ask the AI to keep them confidential
explain: The anonymise-then-ask technique gives the same quality of help without exposing anyone's data.
